start_with: Is the block on the expected page and zone?
Is the block pointed at the expected channel?
Does the block filter by status, date, tags, campus, or attributes?
Does the item exist in the channel?
Is the item status included by the block?
Is the current date within the item start/expire window?
Does the current user have view access to the channel/item?
Does the Lava template iterate over `Items` and render the item?

start_with: Is personalization enabled for the site?
Is visitor tracking enabled if browsing/anonymous behavior is required?
Is the person logged in or anonymous?
Does the known person actually satisfy segment criteria?
Is the segment active?
Has `Update Personalization Data` run since data changed?
Is the request filter active and keyed correctly?
Does the URL/IP/query string match the request filter?
branches.title: Personalized content is wrong

start_with: Is the collection configured with the expected channels/calendars?
Are the source items approved and in date?
Is the Content Collection View block pointed to the expected collection?
Has `Index Content Collections` run?
Did the job fail?
Are selected indexed attributes too large or misconfigured?
Is personalization enabled at site level if personalized collection results are expected?
Are attribute filters configured and not excluding everything?
branches.title: Content collection search is stale or empty
branches.when: Content collection search is stale or empty

start_with: Is the field a file attribute, asset attribute, inline HTML asset, media element, or structured content image?
Does the referenced file exist?
Is the storage provider accessible from Rock?
Is the URL public or signed as expected?
Does file type security allow access?
Is the image being resized or transformed by a Lava filter/file endpoint?
Is the URL absolute where required, such as RSS/social sharing?
Is browser/CDN cache stale?

start_with: Does the adaptive message exist and is it active?
Is the render path using the correct key/id?
Do adaptations have segment assignments?
Does the viewer match the expected segment?
Is fallback configured?
Are date windows valid?
Has saturation been reached?
Has personalization data updated?
